Container.Description:
DSH（DeepSeek Harness）是开源的编码智能体，界面就在浏览器里：它能读改你的项目文件、执行命令、管理模型与会话历史，工具与能力都通过插件扩展。
**为什么用这个镜像** - 自动跟随上游：镜像每天检查上游版本，一有新版本就构建、冒烟测试并推送；你只要在 Docker 页点一次更新，不用改任何配置。 - 命令沙箱真的能用：Unraid 内核没有启用 Landlock，DSH 的沙箱只剩 bubblewrap 一条腿。镜像内置 bubblewrap，模板默认带上它需要的两个启动参数，因此工具不会因为缺少沙箱而拒绝执行。 - 以非 root 身份运行（uid 1000）、多架构（amd64 / arm64）、不含内建密码登录——鉴权交给你的反向代理或受信内网。
**三步开始** 1. 安装并打开 http://<你的服务器IP>:8080 ，首次访问会自动完成登录令牌引导。 2. 状态与项目分别放在 /data 与 /workspace（默认映射到 appdata/dsh/...），升级容器不会丢会话。 3. 放在反向代理之后时，把 PUBLIC_URL 设为对外地址（例如 https://dsh.example.com），容器就只接受该来源的请求；纯内网可留空。
模型凭据在应用界面里配置，本模板不要求填写任何密钥。
**排障** - docker logs <容器名> | head -30 ：启动日志会写明运行模式（edge / lan）、上游版本与启动结果。 - 命令工具报 SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE ：说明模板自带的 Extra Parameters 被删掉了，恢复那两个 --security-opt 即可。
上游项目：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness · 本镜像文档与排障：https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-unraid
--- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) is an open-source coding agent whose interface is a browser tab: it reads and edits your project files, runs commands, and manages models and session history, with everything extensible through plugins.
**Why this image** - Automatic updates: a daily upstream check rebuilds, smoke-tests and publishes whenever a new version lands. You just hit update in the Docker tab. - A command sandbox that actually works: Unraid kernels ship without Landlock, which leaves bubblewrap as the only rung for DSH's sandbox. bubblewrap is bundled and the template carries the two launch options it needs, so commands never refuse to run for lack of isolation. - Runs as non-root (uid 1000), multi-arch (amd64 / arm64), and ships no password login of its own — authentication belongs to your reverse proxy or a trusted LAN.
**Get started in three steps** 1. Install, then open http://<your-server>:8080 — the first visit completes the login-token bootstrap automatically. 2. State and projects live in /data and /workspace (mapped to appdata/dsh/... by default), so upgrading the container keeps your sessions. 3. Behind a reverse proxy, set PUBLIC_URL to the public origin (for example https://dsh.example.com) so the container only answers for that authority; leave it empty on a trusted LAN.
Model credentials are configured inside the app; this template never asks for a key.
**Troubleshooting** - docker logs <container> | head -30 — the entrypoint prints the mode (edge / lan), the upstream version and the startup result. - Tools reporting SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE mean the template's Extra Parameters were removed; restore the two --security-opt values.
Upstream project: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness · Documentation: https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-unraid

Config.Name: WebUI 端口
Config.Description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的宿主侧绑定，格式必须是 IP:端口（Unraid 会把裸端口号误解析成 IP，容器会卡在 Created）。容器内端口固定为 8080；想只让本机访问就改成 127.0.0.1:8080，暴露范围请配合「允许访问的 IP / 域名」一起收紧。| Host-side binding, and it MUST be written as IP:port — Unraid mis-parses a bare port number as an IP and the container stays in Created. The container port is always 8080; use 127.0.0.1:8080 to expose it on the loopback only.

Config.Name: 数据目录
Config.Description: DSH_HOME：会话、凭据、agent home（/data/dsh）与 Caddy 状态。必须是持久化目录，否则重建容器即丢失全部会话。DSH_HOME (sessions, credentials, agents) plus Caddy state; keep it persistent.

Config.Name: 工作目录
Config.Description: 智能体的工作目录（DSH_WORKSPACE），容器启动即 cd 到此。宿主机上建议放需要长期保留的项目。The agent's working directory; the container cd's here at start.容器内也可用 ~/workspace 访问，目录选择器默认就落在这里。Also reachable inside the container as ~/workspace, where the directory picker starts.

Config.Name: 允许访问的 IP / 域名
Config.Description: 只允许这些来源访问界面，逗号分隔。**IP 或 CIDR** 按连接来源地址匹配；**域名**按 Host 头匹配。模板默认已放宽到私有网段（RFC1918 + 链路本地 + Tailscale CGNAT），装完即可从局域网/Tailscale 打开，公网仍进不来——因为公网来源不属于任何一条；想收紧就把多余的网段删掉，只留你自己的。**镜像本身的默认值是严格的 127.0.0.1**（只允许本机），模板只是替你放宽到「不会被公网碰到」的范围。填域名时浏览器必须用该域名访问（经代理时域名应为 PUBLIC_URL 的主机名）。| Only these clients may reach the UI, comma separated: IPs/CIDRs match the peer address, hostnames match the Host header. The default 127.0.0.1 means localhost only (loopback is always allowed because the container's own healthcheck needs it). Add your LAN subnet, or your reverse proxy's address, when something else must connect.

Config.Name: 可信代理网段（可选）
Config.Description: 仅当容器前面有反向代理时填写：Caddy 只对这些来源读取 X-Forwarded-For，从而按**真实客户端 IP** 匹配「允许访问的 IP / 域名」。切勿填写不可信客户端也能发起的网段——那样任何人都能伪造来源绕过白名单。| Only when a reverse proxy fronts this container: Caddy then reads X-Forwarded-For from these peers only, so the allowlist sees the real client address. Never list a range untrusted clients can originate from; they could forge the header and bypass the allowlist.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: 对外访问地址的完整 origin，例如 https://dsh.example.com（不要带路径）。设置后会启用严格模式：DSH 只接受该 authority 的请求，并拒绝其它 Origin。留空 = 局域网模式：仅剥掉 Origin 并把 Host 固定为 loopback，适合受信内网或 VPN。Full origin when a reverse proxy fronts this container; leave empty for a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: DSH_TRUSTED_HOSTS
Config.Description: 额外的可信 authority，逗号分隔（如 dsh.example.com,192.168.1.10:8080）。仅在设置了 PUBLIC_URL 时生效。Extra accepted host[:port] authorities, comma separated; only used together with PUBLIC_URL.
